_comment: The three required axes cannot be off; tests/run_tests.js enforces this.
Do not set a tier key: upstream prohibits overrides, which would require a fork.
Select a set of steps rather than a tier.
This file implements references/tier-profile.md; that document is authoritative on disagreement.

step_1_coverage_matrix.why: Half of requirements-to-response mapping: ensure every RFP item is reflected in the response.

step_12_instruction_critic.why: The other half, precisely what light tier discards. Missing requirements can disqualify a submission.

step_14_5_cite_check.why: One of the few axes with demonstrated effectiveness at blocking entirely hallucinated citations.
step_14_5_cite_check.why_sample_rate: Upstream default 0.6 gives round(1/0.6)=2, or 50% effective coverage. One citation can disqualify a procurement proposal, so require 100%. Change configuration, not code: no fork or upstream-update conflict. See references/cite-check.md for the rationale and stepwise behavior.

step_12_dialectic_critic.why: One of four RACE dimensions; disabling it leaves the dimension unchecked. Use sonnet for diversity of perspective rather than accuracy.

step_10_triple_draft.why: Triple cost justified by stylistic consistency and context saturation, not quality.

budgets._why: Cost and length contracts. source_target satisfies draft-orchestrator must_read_note_ids of 20-50; paragraph lengths inherit upstream char_targets_no_word_boundary CJK tuning. See references/tier-profile.md.

kr_primary.why: Upstream breadth-sweep institutional sources cover only UK Companies House, SEC, and arXiv families. Searches across upstream found zero matches for 나라장터, 조달청, DART, 알리오, RISS, and KCI: a source-coverage gap, not a translation-quality issue.
